payload.question: Did the council spend what it planned on day-to-day services?
payload.label: Day-to-day spending against budget, 2023/24
payload.council_caveat: The council names the causes: £2.8m was a drawdown from reserves that was budgeted for but "wasn't required due to the improved budget position", £1.950m came from a Council-approved change to how it calculates debt repayment, and £1.458m was interest on its day-to-day cash.
payload.evidence: The council set a budget for 2023/24 and its own accounts say it came in 6.23% under — £4.050m less than planned. Both numbers are in the narrative report at the front of that year's Statement of Accounts.
